description:
A lightweight, thread-safe object pooling library for Java applications.
        Features:
        - Thread-safe object pooling using ReentrantLock
        - Configurable pool size with min and max limits
        - Automatic idle object eviction
        - Abandoned object detection and cleanup
        - Support for object validation and health checks
        - Simple and intuitive API
        - Zero external dependencies (except SLF4J for logging)
        - Java 21+ compatible

        Perfect for managing expensive resources like database connections, network sockets, or any reusable objects.
        (can be used for jedis, redisson, etc.)
